sys_script_include.description: HR/ERP-admin-only employee account provisioning: lists accounts needing attention, creates new ServiceNow accounts for new hires, and resets passwords for existing linked accounts. Uses the platform's own password-reset mechanism (password_needs_reset) rather than a custom auth scheme. Temporary passwords are generated here and returned once; they are never stored or logged.
sys_script_include.name: BjitAccountProvisioning
